Conflates prefix caching savings with decode-phase tokens/s. Prefix caching directly reduces prefill, while faster end-to-end response rate does not by itself establish faster token generation. The vLLM documentation explicitly separates these phases.
Batching and padding descriptions are runtime-dependent hypotheses; they should not be presented as universally established causes.
